manifest.name: B2B escrow procurement and milestone settlement
manifest.description: Three independent participants in four bilateral contexts. CNY minor units, basis points, half-up rounding, request-scoped UTC clocks, immutable evidence and capped final payouts. v2 adds optional two-milestone fulfillment without changing v1 single-delivery contracts.

entities.label: agreement
entities.notes: Bilateral procurement agreement. The third party participates through its own contract, not a third signatory on this contract.

rules.label: subtotal
rules.description: Tier two applies to all units when the contractual threshold is met. Integer minor units only.

rules.label: gross
rules.description: Half-up tax-inclusive amount; quotient/remainder avoids overflowing the intermediate base * basis_points.

rules.label: order-quantity
rules.description: Seller order evidence preserves the agreed term for cross-context consumers.

rules.label: order-retention-bps
rules.description: Seller order evidence preserves the agreed term for cross-context consumers.

rules.label: order-daily-penalty-bps
rules.description: Seller order evidence preserves the agreed term for cross-context consumers.

rules.label: order-delivery-deadline
rules.description: Seller order evidence preserves the agreed term for cross-context consumers.

rules.label: locked-amount
rules.description: Custodian locks full funds before delivery. The reference case does not simulate a real banking transfer.

rules.label: acceptance-quantity
rules.description: Buyer final acceptance quantity comes only from seller-formed delivery facts.

rules.label: acceptance-late-days
rules.description: Penalty uses the buyer acceptance instant, not machine-local time. Positive partial days round up; exact deadline has no penalty.

rules.label: release-gross
rules.description: Settlement consumes immutable order evidence, never caller-supplied financial results.

rules.label: release-retention
rules.description: Half-up warranty reserve in minor units.

rules.label: release-penalty
rules.description: Late penalty cannot consume the warranty reserve or make payout negative. Cap before multiplying high rates.
rules.expression: (acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps) >= 10000 ? (settlement.gross_amount_minor - settlement.retention_minor) : (((settlement.gross_amount_minor / 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + ((settlement.gross_amount_minor % 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + 5000) / 10000) > (settlement.gross_amount_minor - settlement.retention_minor) ? (settlement.gross_amount_minor - settlement.retention_minor) : ((settlement.gross_amount_minor / 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + ((settlement.gross_amount_minor % 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + 5000) / 10000))

rules.label: release-payout
rules.description: Final ledger identity: gross = reserve + penalty + seller payout.

rules.label: valid-terms
rules.description: Implementations must reject invalid commercial terms before committing an agreement; monetary results must fit signed int64.
rules.expression: agreement.quantity > 0 && agreement.tier_threshold > 0 && agreement.tier1_unit_price_minor > 0 && agreement.tier2_unit_price_minor > 0 && agreement.tax_bps >= 0 && agreement.tax_bps <= 10000 && agreement.retention_bps >= 0 && agreement.retention_bps <= 10000 && agreement.daily_penalty_bps >= 0 && agreement.daily_penalty_bps <= 10000

rules.label: funded-delivery
rules.description: Physical delivery is allowed only after full custody funds exist.

rules.label: complete-delivery
rules.description: Buyer final acceptance closes only a complete single delivery.

rules.label: funded-release
rules.description: The custodian releases only funded and fully accepted delivery, exactly once per request.

rules.label: milestone-acceptance-late-days
rules.description: Penalty uses the buyer acceptance instant, not machine-local time. Positive partial days round up; exact deadline has no penalty.

rules.label: milestone-release-gross
rules.description: Settlement consumes immutable order evidence, never caller-supplied financial results.

rules.label: milestone-release-retention
rules.description: Half-up warranty reserve in minor units.

rules.label: milestone-release-penalty
rules.description: Late penalty cannot consume the warranty reserve or make payout negative. Cap before multiplying high rates.
rules.expression: (acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps) >= 10000 ? (settlement.gross_amount_minor - settlement.retention_minor) : (((settlement.gross_amount_minor / 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + ((settlement.gross_amount_minor % 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + 5000) / 10000) > (settlement.gross_amount_minor - settlement.retention_minor) ? (settlement.gross_amount_minor - settlement.retention_minor) : ((settlement.gross_amount_minor / 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + ((settlement.gross_amount_minor % 10000) * ((acceptance.late_days * order.daily_penalty_bps)) + 5000) / 10000))

rules.label: milestone-release-payout
rules.description: Final ledger identity: gross = reserve + penalty + seller payout.

rules.label: complete-milestones
rules.description: Two positive milestone deliveries must account for the entire order before buyer final acceptance.
rules.expression: acceptance.accepted && first.delivered_quantity > 0 && final.delivered_quantity > 0 && first.delivered_quantity + final.delivered_quantity == order.quantity && acceptance.accepted_quantity == order.quantity

rules.label: funded-milestone-release
rules.description: An escrow contract chooses single or milestone settlement, never both. Custodian enforces atomic, exactly-once release.
